## Notes

Paid expansion released 2024-10-21: planets Vulcanus, Fulgora, Gleba (agriculture whose produce spoils), and Aquilo (machines freeze without heating); space platforms carry cargo between planets and must shoot down asteroids; adds Quality, Elevated Rails, and the Recycler (75% loss).
